description: Get click analytics for a short link by id (from create_short_link): totals plus breakdowns by day, country, device, browser and referrer. Optional from/to dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

from.description: The first day of the stats window, as a YYYY-MM-DD date.

linkId.description: The id of the short link (from create_short_link) whose click stats should be returned.

to.description: The last day of the stats window, as a YYYY-MM-DD date.

name: get_link_stats
